title: Every Space website ends its footer with a themed Frequency Partner badge linking to the Frequency Spaces page

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16: a small Frequency Partner badge in the bottom right footer of every published site (danieltyack.com, thegrouplocal.com, theheartonfire.com, wildheart), themed to each site's style, linking to the Frequency Spaces marketing page.

detail: The footer carried a plain 'Frequency Partner' text link to the app home, and hid it whenever the Space wrote a copyright suffix (Wildheart, The Group). PartnerBadge (components/sites/site-chrome.tsx) now closes every website footer at its right end: the bolt mark and 'Frequency Partner' in a small pill, linking to <app origin>/spaces. Each theme draws it in its own system: house (DAWN tokens, pill), Menswork (mono label, square hairline), Network (on-ink pill) and Wildheart (label face, hairline pill, centered on a phone). The Space's suffix also links to /spaces.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!c.includes('export function PartnerBadge'))bad.push('no badge');if(!c.includes('<PartnerBadge />'))bad.push('footer does not draw the badge');if(!c.includes('appOrigin()}/spaces'))bad.push('badge does not link to the Spaces page');for(const f of ['house','menswork','network','wildheart'])if(!fs.readFileSync('components/sites/'+f+'-css.ts','utf8').includes('hs-partner'))bad.push(f+' theme does not style the badge');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-995: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
